name: hyperdrain
changelog:
• Automatic Multi-Audio HLS Track Recovery: Automatically detects and recovers separate audio streams (e.g. English/Japanese dubs) for HLS and DASH master playlists, preventing silent video downloads
• Native System FFmpeg Integration: Prioritizes system /usr/bin/ffmpeg, completely eliminating SIGSEGV crash errors during audio extraction and stream muxing
• Smart Pre-flight Disk Space Verification: Checks target drive storage before starting and alerts user if disk space is insufficient
• Ghost Directory Auto-Healing: Automatically falls back to closest existing ancestor directory if target or recent download folder was deleted
